competency_questions.title: Climate models
competency_questions.question: Which climate models have available projections, which institution maintains each of them, of which type are they, and how many simulations use each of them?

queries.title: List climate models
queries.description: List climate models with available projections, organised by institution and type.
queries.query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ccso: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/ccso/>

SELECT
    ?org ?org_label ?org_descr
    ?model_type
    ?model ?model_label ?model_descr
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ?simulation) AS ?num_simulations)
WHERE {
    ?model a ccso:ClimateModel;
        a ?model_type;
        ccso:isMaintainedBy ?org.
    ?org rdfs:label ?org_label.
    OPTIONAL {
        ?org rdfs:comment ?org_descr.
    }
    ?model_type rdfs:subClassOf ccso:ClimateModel.
    ?model rdfs:label ?model_label.
    OPTIONAL {
        ?model rdfs:comment ?model_descr.
    }
    ?simulation ccso:usesModel ?model
}
GROUP BY
    ?org ?org_label ?org_descr
    ?model_type
    ?model ?model_label ?model_descr
ORDER BY ?org ?model_type ?model

competency_questions.title: Model intercomparison experiments
competency_questions.question: Which model intercomparison experiments are represented, which emissions scenario does each of them refer to, and how many models and simulations take part in each?

queries.title: List MIP experiments
queries.description: List the model intercomparison experiments with participating simulations, alongside the emissions scenario they refer to (if any) and the number of participating models and simulations.

competency_questions.title: Models taking part in an experiment
competency_questions.question: Which climate models took part in a given model intercomparison experiment, which institutions maintain them, and how many simulations did each contribute?

queries.title: List models in an experiment
queries.description: List the climate models that took part in a specific experiment (in this case CMIP5 RCP8.5), organised by institution, with the number of simulations run with each model.
queries.query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX top: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/top-level/>
PREFIX ccso: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/ccso/>

SELECT
    ?org ?model ?model_label
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ?simulation) AS ?num_simulations)
WHERE {
    <https://w3id.org/hacid/data/cs/mips/cmip5/experiments/rcp85>
        top:hasComponent+ ?simulation.
    ?simulation a ccso:SingleSimulation;
        ccso:usesModel ?model.
    ?model rdfs:label ?model_label;
        ccso:isMaintainedBy ?org.
}
GROUP BY ?org ?model ?model_label
ORDER BY ?org ?model

competency_questions.title: Standard climate variables
competency_questions.question: Which standard climate variables are defined, and how many datasets provide each of them?

queries.title: List CF variables
queries.description: List climate variables defined in [CF Metadata Conventions](https://cfconventions.org/) and their usage in available projections.

competency_questions.title: Specialisations of a variable
competency_questions.question: Which MIP variables specialise a given standard climate variable, and how many datasets provide each of them?

queries.title: List set of MIP variables
queries.description: List MIP climate variables that specialise a specific CF variable (in this case air temperature) and their usage.

competency_questions.title: Indices relevant to a sector
competency_questions.question: Which climate extreme indices are relevant to a given sector, what do they measure, and from which variable is each of them computed?

queries.title: List set of Climdex indices
queries.description: List climate extreme indices that are associated with a specific sector according to the [Climdex](https://www.climdex.org/) classification (in this case "Water Resources and Food Security"), each one alongside the (MIP) variable from which it is computed.

competency_questions.title: Hazard types
competency_questions.question: Which types of climate hazard are represented, and how many climate indices are associated with each of them?

queries.title: List hazard types
queries.description: List the climate hazard types, with the number of climate indices (from any catalogue) associated with each of them.

competency_questions.title: Indices relevant to a hazard
competency_questions.question: Which climate indices, from any of the integrated catalogues, are relevant to a given type of climate hazard?

queries.title: List indices for a hazard type
queries.description: List the climate indices associated with a specific hazard type (in this case agricultural drought), organised by the catalogue that defines them.
queries.query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX top: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/top-level/>
PREFIX data: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/data/>
PREFIX ccso: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/ccso/>
PREFIX hazard: <https://w3id.org/hacid/data/cs/hazard-types/>

SELECT
    ?catalogue ?index ?index_label ?index_descr
WHERE {
    hazard:AgriculturalDrought ccso:hasIndicator ?index.
    ?index top:isMemberOf ?catalogue;
        rdfs:label ?index_label.
    FILTER(?catalogue != <https://w3id.org/hacid/data/cs/indices>)
    OPTIONAL {
        ?index rdfs:comment ?index_descr.
    }
}
ORDER BY ?catalogue ?index

competency_questions.title: Equivalent indices across catalogues
competency_questions.question: Which climate indices defined in different catalogues are equivalent to each other?

queries.title: List equivalent indices
queries.description: List the Climdex indices that have an equivalent index in another catalogue (e.g., Climate-ADAPT, UK-CRI), whichever direction the equivalence is stated in.

competency_questions.title: Emissions scenarios
competency_questions.question: Which emissions scenarios are defined, of which type are they, and how many simulations refer to each of them?

queries.title: List emissions scenarios
queries.description: List the emissions scenarios, organised by type (e.g., RCPs and SSPs), with the number of simulations referring to each of them.

competency_questions.title: Filter simulations
competency_questions.question: Which simulations refer to a given emissions scenario and provide a given variable at a given spatial resolution, and which model does each of them use?

queries.title: Filter simulations
queries.description: Filter available simulations by chosen emissions scenario (in this case RCP4.5), available variables (in this case tas), and required spatial resolution (in this case less than 0.2 degrees).

competency_questions.title: Filter output datasets
competency_questions.question: Which datasets produced by a given simulation provide a given variable at a given temporal resolution?

queries.title: Filter output datasets
queries.description: Filter datasets from a simulation (in this case cmip5.HadCM3.rcp45.r10i1p1), based on available variables (in this case tas), and required exact temporal resolution (in this case one month).
queries.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX top: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/top-level/>
PREFIX ccso: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/ccso/>
PREFIX data: <https://w3id.org/hacid/onto/data/>
PREFIX mip: <https://w3id.org/hacid/data/cs/variables/mip/>
PREFIX dimension: <https://w3id.org/hacid/data/cs/dimensions/>
PREFIX sim: <https://w3id.org/hacid/data/cs/simulations/>

SELECT ?dataset
WHERE {
    sim:cmip5.HadCM3.rcp45.r10i1p1 data:hasOutput/top:hasPart* ?dataset.
    ?dataset data:holdsSpecializationOfVariable* mip:tas;
        data:dependsOnVariable ?temporalVariable.
    ?temporalVariable
        data:holdsSpecializationOfVariable* dimension:time;
        data:adoptsQuantization/data:hasResolutionValue "P1M"^^xsd:duration.
}
ORDER BY ?dataset

competency_questions.title: Dynamical downscalings of a simulation
competency_questions.question: Which dynamical downscalings of a given global simulation are available, which regional models and institutions produced them, and which area does each of them cover?

queries.title: List dynamical downscalings
queries.description: List dynamical downscaling simulations based on a specific global simulation (in this case cmip5.HadGEM2-ES.rcp26.r1i1p1), organised by institution and regional model, and showing the corresponding spatial coverage.

competency_questions.title: Downscaling chains
competency_questions.question: Which chains of successive downscalings exist, from a global simulation through regional to local simulations, and which model is used at each step?

queries.title: List downscaling chains
queries.description: List the two-step downscaling chains (global, then regional, then local simulation), with the model used at each step.

competency_questions.title: Regional coverage
competency_questions.question: For a given region, which spatial grids and resolutions are available, and how many regional simulations, regional models, and driving global models cover each of them?

queries.title: List grids for a region
queries.description: List the grids defined for a specific CORDEX domain (in this case Europe), with their resolution and the number of regional simulations, regional models, and driving global models using each of them.

competency_questions.title: Actions of the climate service process
competency_questions.question: Which types of action make up the climate service process, how are they organised hierarchically, and which type of information is associated with each of them?

queries.title: List operations
queries.description: List the operations (types of action) defined for the climate service process, each with its direct parent operation and, if defined, the type of the information associated with it.

competency_questions.title: Methods for an action
competency_questions.question: Which methods can be adopted to perform a given kind of processing?

queries.title: List methods of a kind
queries.description: List the methods that specialise a specific kind of method (in this case bias correction), alongside their alternative names.

competency_questions.title: Anomalies of a variable
competency_questions.question: Which anomalies of a given climate variable are defined, with respect to which baseline periods, are they absolute or relative, and how many datasets provide each of them?

queries.title: List anomalies of a variable
queries.description: List the anomaly variables of a variable (in this case near-surface air temperature, tas), with their type (absolute or relative), the baseline period and the number of datasets providing them, directly or as a probability distribution.

competency_questions.title: Previous definitions of MIP variables
competency_questions.question: Which variables defined in earlier editions of the CMOR tables differ from the current MIP variable with the same name, and how are they related to it (change of units or sign)?

queries.title: List previous MIP variables
queries.description: List the variables of previous editions of the CMOR tables that are kept separate from the current MIP variables, with their units and their relation to the current variables (linear transformation for a change of units, opposite value for a change of sign).

competency_questions.title: Probabilistic projections
competency_questions.question: Which probabilistic projections are available for a given emissions scenario, for which variables, and in which representation of the probability distribution (density function, quantile function, or sample)?

queries.title: List probabilistic projections
queries.description: List the variables of the probabilistic projections for a scenario (in this case RCP8.5), with the representation of their distribution and the number of datasets offering each of them (including the versions on other grids).

competency_questions.title: Projections at a global warming level
competency_questions.question: Which projections refer to a given global warming level, from which simulation outputs are they derived, and how many ensemble members do they include?

queries.title: List global warming level projections
queries.description: List the projection productions referring to a global warming level, with the outputs they take as input and the number of their members.

competency_questions.title: Lineage of a dataset
competency_questions.question: From which datasets has a given dataset been derived, through which kind of process (rescaling, aggregation, statistical transformation), and how is it related to them?

queries.title: Show the lineage of a dataset
queries.description: Show the datasets a dataset is derived from (in this case the UKCP18 global projection of member 16 for RCP8.5, regridded from CMIP5 data), with the relation and the process that derived it.
